*F-certmail* (Certified mail) is part of *Layer 1: Channels, Agreement, Ledgers* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: an emerging formulation, still an active area of research.

*References:*

- Pfitzmann, Schunter, and Waidner. [*Provably secure certified mail*](http://dud.inf.tu-dresden.de/sirene/publ/PfSW2CertMail.ps.gz). Technical Report RZ 3207 (\#93253), IBM Research, Zurich, 2000.
